answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 733 Country: India Title: I want to know the names of the animals which Rasulullah (s.a.w) possessed. Question: assalamualikum w.w. I want to know the names of the animals which Rasulullah (s.a.w) possessed. e.g aap (s.a.w) camel, horse etc. Answer ID: 733 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 261/L) The name of she-camel of the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallah) was: Qaswa, as it is mentioned in a Hadith of Sahih Muslim: ثم رکب القصواء حتی اذا استوت بہ ناقتہ علی البیداء (اخرجہ مسلم ، الحج، باب حجة النبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم، رقم 1218) In some other traditions, there have been mentioned some other names as well like Jadaa and Azbaa . The name of the his horse was: Lukhaif , as in Sahih Bukhari: کان للنبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم فرساً یقال لہ: اللحیف۔ قال ابو عبد اللہ: وقال بعضھم: اللخیف (اخرجہ البخاری، الجھاد، باب اسم الفرس والحمار، رقم 2855) While the name of donkey was: Ufair (Bukhari, 2856) Once the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallah) borrowed the donkey of Hazrat Abu Talha, its name was: Mandoob . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
